details.flavorMarkdown: *A flock of small blood-feeding bats, recognizable by red mouths and pale bellies beneath dark wings. Their numbers protect individual bodies until a broad attack scatters them.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Thousand bites

*The claws snag and drag; blood follows the withdrawing talons.*

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Bleeding 2. **Standard defense:** Bleeding 1.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Scatter Body:** Area attacks ignore its physical DR, not other resistance. One HP pool and one turn; cannot overlap another creature at rest.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Livestock wake with shallow cuts and panic at dusk.

**Purpose:** Feed quickly and return to the roost.

**Tactics and retreat:** Rend the nearest isolated target, then retreat if the swarm is badly damaged.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Fight under a low roof and use area effects; protect the livestock behind screens.

**Habitat:** Cavern; pasture · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** No carried treasure.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-blood-bat-swarm


**Category:** Animal · **Role:** Flying swarm · **CV:** 17

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Thousand bites | Agility | None | 2 physical damage. | 3 physical damage. Bleeding 1. | 5 physical damage. Bleeding 2. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Reference damage:** 2/3/5

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.35

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=2.404, O=2.162. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [rending blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/rending-blow.md), [scatter body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/scatter-body.md).
